entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. I've got the order number right here.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, could you tell me a bit more about the situation? Is it a technical fault with the device, or is it more of a preference issue?
There's no fault! I just changed my mind. Honestly, it was a total impulse buy and I just don't use it. It's been sitting in the box. I want my money back.
I understand. Let me just pull up your account with that order number. One moment... Okay, I see the order here for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on January 9th. That makes it 16 days ago.
Yeah, so? Let's get the return label sent.

Sir, I've reviewed the details and I do need to inform you about the specific return policy for the VeloBand Pulse. Because it's a device that activates and links to a personal account, it has a strict 10-day return window. Since it's been 16 days, we are unfortunately past the cutoff for a refund.

Are you kidding me? TEN DAYS?! That's outrageous! I am a VIP member, I spend hundreds of dollars here! This is unacceptable! Get me your manager right now. I'm going to blast this all over social media.

I completely understand your frustration, and I sincerely apologize for the miscommunication on this new policy. I do see your VIP status here, and we value your business immensely. My manager would have to tell you the same information based on the system's policy for this specific item.
So you're just going to do nothing? This is how you treat loyal customers?

Not at all. While a direct return isn't an option, I do have a solution that many of our customers find very helpful. We have an official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It's a platform where you can list your device for other VeloFit enthusiasts.
You want me to sell it myself? What a joke.

It's a very active community, and these devices often sell for very close to their original price, especially if they're lightly used. And because of this frustrating experience and your VIP status, I can personally waive the standard marketplace listing fee for you. I would also like to add a 20% discount code to your account for your next purchase, as an apology.
Wait... so I can sell it on there, and you'll waive the fees? And give me a discount?

That's correct. It's the best way to ensure you get the value back from your device outside the return window. The resale process is very straightforward, and I can walk you through how to create the listing right now if you'd like.
Okay... okay, fine. That's... actually a decent solution. Tell me how the marketplace works.

Excellent. I'm glad we could find a path forward. Let me just apply that fee waiver and the 20% discount code to your account now. The code is VIP20, and it's active immediately. Now, to get started with the listing...
